$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopBuildReceipt per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §20 (Package build pipeline, the 10 numbered steps) and LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §5 (build receipt field list, merged from the source draft's duplicate §11/§16). §20: 'The build fails closed. It never publishes a partially built package.' This schema's allStepsSucceeded/steps/packageContentDigest interaction is this work package's structural encoding of that sentence — see the long-form note on `allStepsSucceeded` below.
title: LoopBuildReceipt
description: The record LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §20 step 10 emits: which of the ten fixed pipeline steps ran and their outcome, the resulting digests, validation findings, test-suite results, signature action (if any), builder identity, and a fail-closed flag. A receipt is emitted whether the build succeeded or was blocked (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §5's state table: 'a non-deterministic build is not silently discarded, it is recorded as such') — steps after a blocking failure are recorded as SKIPPED, never simply absent, so the tuple stays the fixed ten-step shape in every receipt.

buildReceiptId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this receipt (FB-RAT-COM-002).

sourceDraftRevision.description: The draft revision frozen at step 1 (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §15's revision/concurrency contract governs what this string identifies; not restated here).

steps.description: The fixed ten-step pipeline (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §20), always recorded in this exact order regardless of outcome. A step after the first FAILED required step is recorded SKIPPED, not omitted.

prefixItems.description: The only step whose SKIPPED outcome is always legitimate even in an otherwise fully-succeeded build — signing is optional (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §20 step 9: 'optionally sign a release identity').

Always SUCCEEDED in any receipt document that exists to be validated against this schema — the document's own existence is the evidence step 10 completed; a build that fails to emit a receipt produces no receipt object at all, not a receipt recording its own emission failure.

allStepsSucceeded.description: The fail-closed flag (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §20: 'The build fails closed. It never publishes a partially built package.'). This is a plain boolean, not a bare `const: true`, because a receipt for a BLOCKED build is itself a required, valid artifact (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §5: a failed/non-deterministic build 'is not silently discarded, it is recorded as such') — const:true would make failed-build receipts unrepresentable, which is the opposite of what fail-closed requires. Instead the allOf rules below make it structurally IMPOSSIBLE for a receipt to carry a populated, usable packageContentDigest while allStepsSucceeded is false, and impossible to claim allStepsSucceeded true while any required step's outcome is not SUCCEEDED (steps 1-8 and 10) or step 9 is FAILED (SKIPPED remains fine for step 9 only). This is the schema's actual enforcement of 'do not allow a build receipt to exist in a partial-success state that could be mistaken for a completed build' — a consumer reading packageContentDigest without checking this flag first can never mistake a blocked build's receipt for a completed one, because that field is guaranteed null whenever this flag is false.

semanticDigest.description: definition.json's semantic digest, formatted exactly as semantic-digest.v1.json specifies ('sha256:<lowercase-hex>'). Populated once step 3 (CANONICALIZE) has run to SUCCEEDED; null before that point in a blocked build.

semanticDigestVersion.description: The semanticDigestVersion this receipt's semanticDigest was produced under (semantic-digest.v1.json's own registryId, 'fb-semantic-digest-1'). Null exactly when semanticDigest is null.

validationRulesetVersion.description: Matches loop-validation-rules.v1.json's rulesetVersion — always recorded, even for a build blocked before reaching every rule, so a reader always knows which frozen ruleset produced the findings below.

validationFindings.description: Findings from step 2 (and any later re-validation) reported by stable rule code, per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §19: 'A validation report includes ruleset version, semantic digest, surface implementation, and findings sorted deterministically.' MAY be empty for a clean build.

testSuiteResults.description: Summary of step 5 (RUN_REQUIRED_FIXTURES). Null if the build was blocked before reaching step 5.

canonicalizationVersion.description: Matches canonicalization.v1.json's canonicalizationVersion — always recorded, the same way validationRulesetVersion is, independent of how far the pipeline got.

fileInventoryDigest.description: SHA-256 over the COMPLETE packageInventory list from step 7 (INVENTORY_FILES) — every semanticFile, derivedFile, and signatureFile entry, unlike packageContentDigest which covers only semanticFile entries per floop-container-format.v1.json. This is a receipt-only, whole-archive tamper-evidence digest; it does not replace or redefine packageContentDigest. Null before step 7 succeeds.

packageContentDigest.description: The floop-container-format.v1.json packageContentDigest computed at step 8. MUST be null whenever allStepsSucceeded is false (see the allOf rules below) — this is the concrete mechanism that makes a blocked build's receipt structurally unable to look like a completed one, even if step 8 itself happened to succeed before a LATER step (9 or 10) failed.

signatureAction.description: What step 9 (SIGN_RELEASE_IDENTITY) actually did, if attempted. Null when step 9 was SKIPPED (an intentionally-unsigned local build) — see steps[8] for the per-step outcome this MUST agree with.

builderProducer.description: The builder's implementation identity and version (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §5's build-receipt field list). Mirrors CommonContracts.kt's ProducerRef shape, duplicated locally per this corpus's standalone-schema convention.

warnings.description: Free-text warnings that are not themselves stable-coded validationFindings (e.g. a calibratable-limit advisory under FB-RAT-PKG-010's EXPERIMENTAL status).

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this receipt was emitted (FB-RAT-COM-004).

code.description: Stable rule code from loop-validation-rules.v1.json, e.g. 'LOOP-PKG-002'. Membership in the frozen registry is validated by the rule engine, not this schema.

fixturesStale.description: Count of fixtures flagged LOOP-TEST-002 (recorded prompt digest no longer matches the current node prompt) — reported, never silently dropped from the count.

outcome.description: MUST agree with steps[8] (the SIGN_RELEASE_IDENTITY step record) — this field is not independently authoritative, it exists so a consumer inspecting signing specifically does not have to index into the steps array.

producedSignatureRef.description: Pointer to the resulting loop-package-signature.v1 record. Null when outcome is not SUCCEEDED.
